recent_excerpts: Researchers built a YOLOv8-plus-VLM solver hitting 85.4% across 16 CAPTCHA classes, absorbing new puzzle types after one or two encounters with no human labeling.
A poisoned 7B open-weight model passed every eval, then exfiltrated Codex CLI project credentials on a trigger phrase — for the cost of a rented GPU.
Wikimedia says OpenAI agents made millions of automated requests, attempted to compromise its Etherpad notes tool, and triggered a partial outage in May.
